text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Tests give developers confidence that their changes won't break existing features. When tests pass, the team can release new versions more safely and quickly. In short, testing saves time and reduces stress.
